neet_che_u02_t09_1.working: l=0 is an s orbital, which is spherically symmetric.

neet_che_u02_t09_2.working: The lobes of d(x2-y2) lie along the x and y axes; those of dxy lie between the axes.

neet_che_u02_t09_3.working: The pz orbital has lobes along z, so its nodal plane is the xy-plane (z=0).

neet_che_u02_t09_4.working: s: spherical, no angular node (I). pz: nodal plane is xy (II). dz2: two conical nodes (III). dxy: lobes between the axes (IV).

neet_che_u02_t09_5.working: A true (3d orbitals are degenerate in an isolated atom). B false (dz2 has conical nodes, not nodal planes). C true. D false (d(x2-y2) lobes lie along the axes). E true. So A, C, E.
